description.zh:
配置对应的ID。
>调用[DescribeCycleTaskList](~~DescribeCycleTaskList~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the configuration.
>Call the [DescribeCycleTaskList](~~DescribeCycleTaskList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

Specifies whether to enable the task. Valid values:
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

description.zh:
扫描周期的单位，取值：
- **day**：天。
- **hour**：小时。
description.en:
The unit of the scan cycle. Valid values:
- **day**: day.
- **hour**: hour.
The task end time, in hours.
The task start time, in hours.

description.zh:
任务名称。
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**：病毒扫描。
- **IMAGE_SCAN**：镜像扫描。
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**：应急漏洞扫描。
description.en:
The node name. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.

description.zh:
任务类型。
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**：病毒扫描。
- **IMAGE_SCAN**：镜像扫描。
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**：应急漏洞扫描。
description.en:
The node type. Valid values:
- **VIRUS\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: virus scan.
- **IMAGE_SCAN**: image scan.
- **EMG\_VUL\_SCHEDULE\_SCAN**: emergency vulnerability scanning.
